KEEP exactly one illusionary copy of the caster lasting3rounds. NEW place one visual/audible image matching the caster's actual visible body/equipment at a perceived legal open position within60feet/line of effect. It is a nonphysical image in the caster's current size/appearance snapshot,not a creature/object withHP. The copied appearance does not update when the caster later transforms or changes clothes;creating a replacement pays a new cast. It produces ordinary conversational speech/simple body sounds in the caster's known voice/languages,not light,heat,smell,force,real music powers or a new sensory feed. NEW no concentration;ends at the caster's third future regular START or18elapsed seconds outside initiative,preserving the original marker/deadline through extra turns and absence.

Once on each actual ordinary caster turn,an available Bonus Action can move the image up to30feet through a declared continuous path within60feet/caster line of effect and direct one brief mundane performance or sentence. It cannot pass through walls,closed doors or another solid barrier;it may visually imitate an actual apparent locomotion the snapshot body has,but that creates no cargo/support/anatomy permission. It can overlap real creatures because it lacks substance,without blocking them. The Bonus Action uses the real action wallet;the image gets no independent turn or attack. With no command it holds its last position/pose and continues only a previously declared simple idle appearance,not independent plans,choices or secret observations. Losing command range leaves it stationary until expiry,not invisibly following the caster.

NEW decoy function:while this image is within5feet of its actual caster and both are legal visible candidate positions for an incoming direct attack roll,a sight-dependent attacker who has not identified this image as false cannot visually distinguish them during the spell's brief identical-image shimmer. Select uniformly among the caster and this live indistinguishable image before rolling. If actual Mirror Image duplicates also legally qualify,use one combined uniform selection among the caster and all eligible live visual duplicates,not serial independent miss chances. No image outside the attack's real reach/range/line of effect joins that selection. A source explicitly ignoring visual illusions,actual True Seeing,or that attacker's genuine recognition removes the corresponding false candidate.

If the true caster is selected,resolve that one attack normally. If Arcane Clone is selected,roll against the caster's current realAC;hit ends this clone,miss leaves it. No numericHP damage,critical body injury,on-hit resource,corpse or actual creature-target rider is generated. The attack's ordinary ammunition/action costs stay spent. At a separate position outside the decoy pairing,the image can be deliberately mistaken for an apparent creature and attacked using this same image-hit procedure,but it never automatically intercepts an attack on the caster. Caster/allies cannot intentionally farm hits/procs from their known false image. Area/save effects ignore it;it grants no cover,flanking or reaction interception. Choosing among overlapping valid visual duplicates occurs only once for the original attack lineage.

An observer may spend an Action on INT(Investigation)against the original spellDC to recognize the image;real direct physical passage/touch showing no substance establishes recognition without a roll for that observer. Identification leaves its appearance for others but removes its own mechanical deception against that observer. True Seeing uses its actual source scope. A known false image cannot block that observer's sight,though unrelated actual terrain still can. An imitated casting gesture is no real spell commitment and creates no Counterspell trigger,RP payment,spell copy or new attack. A genuine readied response to an actually observed movement/sound can still use its real trigger rules;the image does not force anyone to respond.

One Arcane Clone per caster;successful new creation replaces the old,without returning resources or resetting an attack already begun. Suppression hides the image and removes its decoy candidacy while the original deadline continues;missed commands do not queue,and return supplies no new duplicate or forgotten-disbelief reset. Actual dispel,expiry,a qualifying hit or caster death ends it. This is neither a biological clone,extra class sheet,stored consciousness,death replacement nor soul transfer.

precondition.value: Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F. KEEP reversal of an ongoing magical effect, including the source’s Heal-to-Harm example. NEW select one individually perceived live target-local numerical component of an actual ordinary spell of generating rank at most four, with line of effect to its real recipient/anchor. Name exactly one admissible inverse from this finite table: (1) a future normal-HP healing output becomes necrotic damage of the same computed amount; (2) a future direct damage output becomes normal-HP healing of the same computed amount; (3) a flat AC, attack-roll, ability-check or saving-throw modifier changes sign with the same magnitude; (4) one typed resistance becomes vulnerability to that same type, or vice versa; (5) a stated double-Speed multiplier becomes half-Speed, or a half-Speed multiplier becomes double-Speed, using the actual native Speed arbitration. One selected component, including its linked repeated future opportunities, is modified; other parent components remain themselves. No inverse is supplied for immunity, hard control, conditions, transformation, Invisible/sensory information, temporary/form HP, HP maxima, RP/charges/items, physical work, creature creation, damage transfer, a portal or a completed instantaneous result. An actual spell-created companion’s heal/attack is eligible only if it is an explicitly defined output component of the ongoing spell parent with all its original command/offense budgets, rather than an independent creature feature inferred from a name. Make one casting-ability plus PB task check against DC 10 + twice the actual generating rank, Core degrees/natural shifts collapsed to success/failure. Success installs the chosen inversion; failure changes nothing. Unknown rank/component ineligibility can defeat a paid attempt without disclosing hidden facts. NEW reversal requires no concentration of its own and lasts only until the parent/component ends or sixty seconds from reversal, whichever is earlier. Original owner, statistics, concentration, targets, costs, eligibility, schedule, reserves and already spent opportunities remain. It does not reset a tick, create a new recipient or revive ended concentration. A specific parent/component may be successfully inverted only once in its lifetime across all casters; the consumed inversion flag survives suppression/removal, and the inversion cannot itself be selected for recursive inversion. Qualifying removal of the reversal restores only the surviving parent’s original future behavior, never past results or consumed opportunities. For output conversion, retain the original legal trigger/attack/save and source-funded amount. Compute the numerical amount through its source’s ordinary formula, actual limit and relevant source funding, before the original recipient’s healing-specific or damage-specific mitigation. An HP-healing reserve that would be debited only for actual restoration instead commits no more than this converted amount from its remaining reserve once; it cannot emit free damage while keeping that budget. Apply the final category’s actual target rules and defenses once: converted damage uses necrotic immunity/resistance/prevention/buffers and can cause ordinary Wounds/concentration; converted healing uses living-recipient eligibility, actual healing restrictions and maximum-HP cap, with no resurrection or excess reserve. No healing-only bonus/prohibition is copied into necrotic defenses, and no damage resistance is applied a second time to converted healing. Any source-specific fraction/funding explicitly based on an earlier real damage event still needs that genuinely qualifying earlier event; conversion cannot fund itself, create reciprocal drain healing, or use reflected/copied output as a fresh source occurrence. An attack-origin converted heal does not become two events or a free second attack; original hit/secondary riders retain only their expressly independent scope, while damage-dependent riders see no damage from the converted component. A save that originally halves the eligible source output retains that half before final-category processing; a success preventing the original output supplies nothing to convert. Resolve signed numeric and resistance/Speed changes through their actual stat rules, preserving separate source records; multiple reversals cannot add duplicate magnitude. The Healing tag grants no new heal and the Heal-to-Harm example never undoes HP already restored.

MM127-REVERSAL-01 — NEW Water Pet exception and category boundary. The exact AC4 Water Pet parent explicitly permits its 2d6 heal or cold attack in the same original-owner/numbered-round offensive/support slot. This Reversal deliberately authorizes conversion of that native heal despite the parent's ordinary no-conversion restriction; no other generic source exception follows. Its original owner's real Bonus Action command, true attached phase, pet Action, willing eligible ally at5ft/line of effect, ordinary parent concentration and deadline all remain. There is no healing reserve. The native 2d6 computed potential is not limited to target missing HP before conversion; final category handles HP cap/defenses. Original living-ally eligibility and actual informed willingness remain requirements, including knowledge that the present command will deliver harm. A heal prohibition alone does not prohibit necrotic damage; it is never consumed as a next-heal reducer by the converted damage. No owner personal cast/heal trigger or free command occurs.
For an original healing-only opportunity converted to damage, create the damage root after the native action/trigger legality and source funding checks and before mitigation. Dealer is the actor actually producing the native healing: Water Pet here, NOT the inverter or its controller. Snapshot that dealer's actually qualifying Null state then; do not invent one. For an already damage-rooted component converted to healing, retain original lineage/Null history but emit no damage event, Wound, damage resource or damage-dependent secondary rider. Independent native costs and recipient riders remain where their own text still applies. No simultaneous normal heal accompanies converted damage.
MM127-REVERSAL-02 — Component identity and lifetime. Attach to one permanent parent-component key and, when the source is recipient-local, its one real application key. A native pet healing action that selects willing allies on later commands is one action component, not an invented permanent single-target roster; later legal targets are native command selections. Mark the successful inversion before callbacks. The mark survives dispelling/suppression of this modifier. Inversion of this modifier itself is illegal. An eligible otherwise lawful removal may end this rank4 modifier alone; it does not end the surviving original parent. Temporary suppression only suspends future conversion and never banks an opportunity.
The synthetic eight-unit reserve obligation remains conditional on an independently authorized spell reserve. For such a genuinely supplied source, commit the converted potential from that actual reserve once, capped by its available units; no reserve is granted to Water Pet. Actual ongoing modifier records traveling with a Spell-Theft-eligible original bundle retain these identities and clocks.

Keep the parent's actual center,shape,area,range,concentration,targets,damage dice,ownership and source lifetime. An absent exact Fly card remains an unresolved original content example; no substitute foreign Fly or free acquired flight is added.

NEW for one elapsed hour,no concentration, the recipient temporarily knows AND has prepared/available those exact three class-qualified spells in addition to its ordinary repertoire cap. This is the explicit exception that makes the printed learning usable. No free cast,RP recovery,maximum increase,focus,material,school,class level,once-rest use or template knowledge is created. One Communion grant per recipient across casters; successful new full application replaces all three old permissions and starts its own hour, never adds another three. Suppression disables only these extra permissions while its original clock runs; ordinary independently known/prepared access to the same ID remains. A new cast must have real access when committed and while any source-required extended casting still needs the knowledge; grant loss during that incomplete work can prevent completion without refund. A spell already genuinely cast within the window,including a readied spell whose casting already completed, keeps its own effect/release window/concentration and original owner even after the learning grant ends; no new cast is allowed from the expired grant. Ongoing effects are not rebound to the Communion caster. Notes may describe observations, but the temporary learning does not itself produce a durable decipherable spell formula,permanent spellbook entry,teaching credential or lasting known/prepared slot. Any independent actual source that specifically grants learning from a completed real cast must meet its own requirements; this proposal grants no generic path to permanent retention. Existing Spell Theft transfers certain already-existing buffs, not learned-spell permission; its draft is a comparison only and cannot transfer this three-spell bank. Death,removal or expiry ends the grant without reviving it on return to life. Normal retained learned knowledge/resources from other sources are untouched.
